properties.name: Ra
properties.description: Supreme sun god of Egypt. Sailed across the sky by day and through the underworld by night. All pharaohs were his sons.

properties.name: Osiris
properties.description: God of the afterlife, death, and resurrection. Murdered by Set and resurrected by Isis. Judge of the dead in the Hall of Two Truths.

properties.name: Isis
properties.description: Goddess of magic, motherhood, and wisdom. Reassembled and resurrected Osiris. One of the most worshipped deities in the ancient world.

properties.name: Anubis
properties.description: Jackal-headed god of mummification and the afterlife. Guided souls to judgment and weighed hearts against Ma'at's feather.

properties.name: Thoth
properties.description: Ibis-headed god of wisdom, writing, and magic. Inventor of hieroglyphics. Keeper of divine records. Mediator between cosmic forces.

properties.name: Sekhmet
properties.description: Lion-headed goddess of war and destruction. Her bloodlust nearly destroyed humanity. Also goddess of healing — the one who wounds can heal.

properties.name: Set
properties.description: God of chaos, storms, and the desert. Murdered his brother Osiris. Complex deity — also protector of Ra against Apophis. Both villain and champion.

properties.name: Hathor
properties.description: Cow-headed goddess of love, beauty, and joy. Gentle aspect of Sekhmet. Welcomed the dead to the afterlife. Nurse of pharaohs.

properties.name: Horus
properties.description: Falcon-headed god of the sky. Son of Osiris and Isis. Avenged his father by defeating Set. Living pharaohs were his embodiment.

properties.name: Bastet
properties.description: Cat-headed goddess of home, fertility, and protection. Once fierce (lioness), she became gentle (cat). Her festival at Bubastis was Egypt's largest.

properties.name: Ptah
properties.description: Creator god of Memphis. Created the world through speech and thought (logos). Patron of craftsmen and architects. Father of Nefertem.

properties.name: Ma'at
properties.description: Goddess of truth, justice, and cosmic order. Her feather weighed against the heart of the dead. Without Ma'at, the universe returns to chaos.

properties.name: Nephthys
properties.description: Goddess of death and mourning. Sister of Isis, Osiris, and Set. Protector of the dead. Together with Isis, she mourned Osiris and guided souls.

properties.name: Khepri
properties.description: Scarab-headed god of the dawn and self-creation. Pushed the sun across the sky like a dung beetle rolls its ball. Embodiment of daily renewal.
